title: Prove a uniform rounding margin for all 24 orders of two selected source factors
short_pr_body:
## Result
Prove an explicit Cp-bit margin for all24 vertex orders of two extremal physical factors and their inverse, including matched periodic aliases.

## Checks
`python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/extremal-phase-two-axis-margin`
Independent review and negative controls passed. Base `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. Predecessors: #6099, #7000.

## Limits and credit
No new kappa; all five full assumptions remain. Fixed two-axis selected pairs; table-production admission and growing dimensions remain open; exact three-axis box nonextension included. Prepared for @CubeJerry; credit to cited predecessors and substantial OpenAI assistance.
